already.title: You're already a teacher here
already.body: Your account is already linked to a teacher in this school.

staffId.title: Enter your staff ID
staffId.body: Your email does not match a teacher record in this school. Enter your staff ID and your school admin will check the request.
staffId.label: Staff ID
staffId.unknown: No teacher has this staff ID. Check it and try again.
staffId.taken: This staff ID is already linked to an account. Ask your school admin to unlink it if it should be yours.
staffId.hint: Already sent a request? Sending it again is fine; your admin sees only the latest.

pending.title: Waiting for your school admin
pending.body: Your request was sent. When your school admin approves it, open this link again or sign in to see your timetable.

errors.linkInvalid: The link was turned off, replaced, already used or has expired. Ask your school admin for a new one.
errors.alreadyLinked: This teacher record is already linked to an account, or your account is already linked to a teacher in this school. Ask your school admin to unlink it if this is wrong.
errors.tooManySchools: This account already belongs to the most schools allowed (15).
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.notAllowed: This account can't join. Sign in with a verified email and try again.
errors.generic: Could not join the school. Please try again.
